source: [PC] photo_capture_spec.md §1-§3 (FR-005, ASM-005). Pose ranges and the 9 guidance items are initial values set during development (ASM-002).
guidance: Look straight at the camera, or at the angle shown for this step
Move hair and anything else away from your face
Hold the camera about an arm's length away
Only your head should be in the photo
Keep your whole head and neck in the frame
Keep the camera steady so the photo isn't blurry

angles.label: Front
angles.instruction: Face the camera head-on with a neutral expression.
angles.turnHint: Look straight at the camera, with your nose pointing at the lens.

angles.label: Left 3/4
angles.instruction: Turn your head to your right, about 45 degrees, so your left cheek faces the camera.
angles.turnHint: Turn your head to your right, about 45 degrees, so your left cheek faces the camera.

angles.label: Right 3/4
angles.instruction: Turn your head to your left, about 45 degrees, so your right cheek faces the camera.
angles.turnHint: Turn your head to your left, about 45 degrees, so your right cheek faces the camera.
